subject: Fix compatibility issue for death test with Valgrind (#3301)
reason: The change modifies only the C++ unit-test infrastructure: an example death test in src/unit/example_tests.cpp now uses serverAssert(false) instead of a raw SEGV, and src/unit/main.cpp sets GoogleTest's death_test_style to 'threadsafe' when running under Valgrind. These files are part of the gtest unit-test binary, not valkey-server or any shipped tool, so no runtime behaviour, command reply, replication, persistence or cluster path changes. There is nothing for a fuzzer scenario against real servers to exercise.
